skills.name: 笃烈
skills.officialText: 每回合限一次，你成为其他角色基本牌或普通锦囊牌的唯一目标时，你可令此牌的效果结算两次，然后你摸X张牌（X为你的攻击范围且至多为5）。

skills.name: 斗缠
skills.officialText: 锁定技，准备阶段，你从牌堆中获得一张【决斗】，否则你的攻击范围和出牌阶段使用【杀】的次数+1（增加次数不超过游戏人数）。

implementationContract: Dulie directly uses the established sole-incoming native effect-repeat operation, once per whole actual turn. It repeats the native effect without fabricating a second Use. After both effects and their children, the original Use draws its current attack range capped at five.

Douchan has the OL fixed-one obtain count, unlike the separate Shanhe activity maximum-HP variant. It obtains one physical Duel from the current DrawPile, not a generated card and not a Draw operation. Its actual movement invoice and native gain/replacement children determine obtained versus otherwise.

Otherwise grants one permanent attack-range and ordinary Play Slash-quota increment. The accepted engineering interpretation freezes game population as the initial player-slot count, rather than live survivors; the total named-skill growth budget does not reset on source withdrawal, regrant or a new source instance.

At the total-growth cap, the actual shortfall remains one and the grant increment is zero. Issued grants remain permanent after source loss, following the pre-existing sequential deck-shortfall contribution contract. New preparations require an active source.

The existing owning sequential-acquisition frame retains exact preparation identity, original source and content hash, paid movement batches, and typed gain-child returns. It does not repay an obtained entity on cold restoration or source loss. Native death and terminal cutoffs remain unchanged.
